item.title: Midwest States and the Shady City
item.description: Welcome to episode 9 of the Grey Duck Running Podcast. This week we talk a bit about a world record being broken, Tadej (sadly) being broken during stage 8 of the Vuelta. The races we covered this week are the Midwest States 100 and the Shady City Race. Tune in next week for Christians big Vikings announcemnt.

item.title: Are We Out of the Woods???
item.description: Welcome back to Grey Duck Running! Lauren made it out of the Coon Forks 40 with just a few scratches (and a bruised ego). Then we cover the Shawnee Hills Trail Races in Ozark Illinois and some of the southern food you could try in that area. Lastly we cover Marathon Countys own marathon in Wausau, along with some of our favorite places we've been (or want to go to) in the area.

item.title: Shawshanked
item.description:
Welcome back to the Grey Duck Running Podcast! This week we have an exciting announcment; we have offically launched a website! Then we talk a bit about our personal trainning and some fun odds and ends from our week. We cover our first race in Ohio, the Shawshank Hustle, hosted on the Historic Ohio State Reformatory grounds. Our trail race this week was up in Marquette Michigan, the Marquette Trail 50. Finally we cover the RAMP River Run in Illinois.

Grey Duck Running Website: https://greyduckrunning.com/

Ohio State Reformatory:https://www.mrps.org/

NTN Trails:https://www.noquetrails.org/

item.title: Pure Water Days 2026
item.description:
Hello, welcome to episode six of the Grey Duck Running podcast and this week we are here to talk about Pure Water Days in Chippew Falls Wisconsin! We both raced in the YMCA/Senn Blacktop Pure Water Days Half Marathon, we then talk about some of the other events for the town festival including the parade, Resonate, and a few local businesses. Stay tuned to hear about the two races we highlighted this week, the Mines of Spain Trail Race in Dubuque Iowa, and the Gopher Badger Races in Stillwater/Lake Elmo Minnesota. Lastly we talk a bit about our trail running experiences this past week with the North Side Night (Run) Club and Blue Ox.



https://nocoasttrailseries.com/

Sun Trail Running https://suntrailrunning.com/


Pinehurst Park https://www.pinehurstpark.org/ CORBA https://corbatrails.org/


Check out Resonate https://www.facebook.com/band.resonate/

item.title: Free Throw Contest + Valentine Marathon and Badger Trail Races
item.description:
Happy August from us here at Grey Duck Running! This week we are back from vacation and ready to talk about some racing. Before getting into the races we debrief our week at the cabin/lollapalooza. Next, we talk about the results of the Valentine Marathon in Valentine Nebraska. Then we come back to Wisconsin to talk about the Badger Trail Races that runs along the Badger State Trail starting in Belleville Wisconsin.



Valentine Marathon: https://valentinemarathon.com/


Bolo Beer co: https://www.bolobeer.com/welcome-1


Badger Trail Races: https://www.tenjunkmilesracing.com/badgertrailrace

item.title: Vaycay Mode!!!
item.description: On this weeks episode we interview Christian's Mom, Stephine! She tells us about what it is like spectating running events and a bit about her business Awake and Rising. We also discuss some races that happed near us this past weekend in Alexandria Minnesota!

item.title: Fight Night Preview and Storm The Farm Recap
item.description:
Welcome back to Grey Duck Running! In this episode we have our first interview with Lauren's sister, Brianne! They talk about how martial arts has helped in their everyday lives as well as strategies for Fight Night at Zimmerman's Freestyle Martial Arts. Christian talks about the results from the Storm The Farm Event in Winona Minnesota, presented by Storm Sporting Events.


Storm Sporting Events:https://www.stormsportingevents.org/event-details/storm-the-farm


Ragbrai:

https://ragbrai.com/


Zimmerman's Freestyle Martial Arts:

https://zimmermansfreestyle.com/

item.title: Ride Across Wisconsin Recap and Twin Cities Marathon News
item.description:
Welcome back to The Grey Duck Running Podcast!

This week Lauren recaps her Ride Across Wisconsin (RAW) century ride. We give a rough overview of some of the major Tour De France events so far and give some information on Fierce Freedom and their upcoming Eau Freedom Fun Run and Fest.


Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/greyduckrunning?utm_source=qr

Fierce Freedom: https://fiercefreedom.org/


Wisconsin Bike Fed: https://wisconsinbikefed.org/

item.description:
Introducing the Grey Duck Running Podcast. Get to know us, how we got into running and some of our other passions. We recap our Fourth of July weekend and preview some events we have coming up.
